title: HAI Types and Their Causative Agents
description: Flip each card to review the major causative organisms for each HAI type.

tips.front: Think about organisms that colonise urinary catheters
Which organisms form biofilms on intravascular devices?

dialogs.answer: S. aureus (including MRSA), CoNS, E. coli, Pseudomonas, Enterococcus

tips.front: Skin flora and enteric organisms are the main culprits

dialogs.answer: Clostridioides difficile — toxin-producing, spore-forming anaerobe; associated with antibiotic use and disrupted gut flora

tips.front: This organism forms spores resistant to alcohol-based hand rubs
